# Eero Siivola

> Official personal website of Eero Siivola, a Helsinki-based Data Scientist & AI Architect with more than ten years of experience in machine learning.

Eero turns uncertain data into AI and decision systems that people can trust and use. His work connects problem framing, machine-learning models, data workflows, software, technical leadership, and operational delivery. He works at Vuono Group and holds a Doctor of Science degree in machine learning from Aalto University.

This website is the authoritative source for Eero's current public profile. Detailed claims are supported by links to public articles, institutional records, papers, and source-code repositories.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://esiivola.github.io/): Current role, selected work, recent writing, and professional overview.
- [Work](https://esiivola.github.io/work/): Public examples of work in data quality, environmental monitoring, AI processes, and machine learning with uncertain data.
- [Writing](https://esiivola.github.io/writing/): Articles about AI, business processes, data quality, and environmental monitoring.
- [About](https://esiivola.github.io/about/): Career history, education, capabilities, technologies, and personal interests.

## Research and code

- [Research archive](https://esiivola.github.io/research/): Selected publications and open-source implementations covering Gaussian processes, Bayesian optimisation, human feedback, active learning, and pediatric drug dosing.

- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.fi/citations?user=W7oj2YAAAAAJ): Full academic publication record.
